values.content:
Create a 3-minute nursery rhyme video for YouTube Kids (ages 2-5).

Output ONLY valid JSON with this exact structure:
{
  "title": "string - catchy, kid-friendly, < 60 chars",
  "description": "string - 2-3 sentences, includes keywords",
  "tags": ["string", "..."],
  "playlist": "string - playlist name or ID",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "duration": 12,
      "prompt": "string - detailed SDXL prompt for this scene: character + setting + mood + style. Consistent character description. 2D nursery rhyme illustration style, bright colors, simple shapes.",
      "lyrics": "string - 1-2 lines of lyrics shown on screen during this scene",
      "narration": "string - voiceover text for this scene (spoken, not sung)"
    }
    // ... 12-15 scenes total, durations sum to ~180 seconds
  ],
  "backgroundMusic": "string - mood/tempo for CC0 music search (e.g. 'cheerful acoustic ukulele 80bpm')"
}

Requirements:
- Main character: A friendly animated bunny named "Benny" - round, soft, big ears, blue shirt, always smiling
- Educational theme: colors, numbers, animals, or daily routines
- Simple repetitive lyrics kids can sing along
- Gentle, soothing tone
- Each scene 10-15 seconds
- Total ~180 seconds (3 minutes)
- Scene prompts must include: "Benny the bunny, round soft blue shirt, big ears, 2D vector illustration, nursery rhyme style, bright pastel colors, simple shapes, clean lines"
- Lyrics timed to match scene duration
- Narration separate from lyrics (spoken storyteller voice)
